title: Implement residency-assertion-proxy and RBAC policy attenuator
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a residency assertion proxy to centralize per-request jurisdiction checks and a RBAC policy attenuator that enforces temporal limits and operator-scope filters. No user-facing API changes.
description: Background: Customers in regulated jurisdictions were asking for stronger per-request residency proofing and a simpler way to express short-lived operator delegations. This PR introduces a lightweight residency-assertion-proxy service and an RBAC policy attenuator that can be composed into the request path to enforce timebound and locality-scoped grants. Motivation: consolidate residency checks in a single place, improve audit signals with residency provenance, and reduce policy complexity for cross-region operator flows. Changes are designed to be opt-in via config flags and default to non-blocking with telemetry-only mode.

review_threads:
Evan Liu (reviewer): Can you clarify attack surface if an operator token is replayed across regions? Suggested adding nonce in the residency token.
Priya: Added per-request nonce to the residency JWT and extended verification to check nonces in the request cache (ttl=30s).

Marisol Vega (reviewer): Audit format needs a residency.proof.signature field so SIEM can validate later.
Priya: Added immutable audit field residency.proof.signature and a provenance verifier in pkg/audit/verify.go; updated docs.

Tomás Ortega (reviewer): Helm chart should expose telemetry-only mode for migration.
Priya: Exposed residencyProxy.enabled and residencyProxy.telemetryOnly flags and added runbook steps to flip the flag safely.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: introducing a new proxy in the hot path could add latency and cause false rejections. Mitigation: telemetry-only opt-in, staged rollout via helm chart, per-route toggles, and a canary job that exercises residency validation. Added observability - per-request residency latency and rejection rate metrics.
testing_plan: Unit tests for Attenuator rules, residency JWT parsing and nonce handling. Integration tests for cross-region request flows and KMS provenance header scenarios. Load test to measure median p95 added latency (target <1ms added on p50 for cached cases).
security_considerations: Residency tokens are signed with a dedicated KMS key; service verifies key origin and enforces region affinity before trusting a claim. Attenuator prevents long-lived operator grants by capping delegated duration and honoring deny-lists. Audit events include signed residency provenance to support non-repudiation.
qa_notes: QA exercised config permutations: telemetry-only, enforce-mode, and per-route opt-out. Discovered an edge-case where stale nonces caused spurious rejects under heavy retries; addressed by exponential nonce windowing. No regressions in existing auth flows.
merge_outcome: Merged after two approvals and green CI. Canary rolled to 10% traffic for 48 hours then to 100% with telemetry-only -> enforce flip staged across regions.
notes_for_release_manager: No migrations required. Recommend including short blurb in the next security bulletin: 'Added residency-proof middleware and RBAC policy attenuator (config opt-in)'. Coordinate helm flag flip with SRE during off-peak hours.
